text:
Jorie (Marketing): Hey team — new run draft for next Tues. Need quick confirms: final topic line, who handles lead flags, and fallback plan for the live demo. Short replies please.

Cal (Producer): Runtime target 36m: 2m intro, 18m demo+cases, 8m panel, 8m Q&A+wrap. Green room 20m prior.

Nadia (Host): I can open with a 45s framing and a 2-line fallback if demo stalls: 'If responses slow, well show the lightweight example in docs and follow up with code snippets.' OK?

Ravi (Speaker): Fine. I'll tighten demo to 15m with a 3m case study so transitions stay tight. Uploading slides v2 tonight.

Tess (Growth): I'll triage leads in Q&A. Suggest private channel #webinar-1797-leads for lead flags and quick notes. I'll drop MQLs there.

Cal (Producer): Created channel and added Tess + Ravi + InfraOnCall. CueBot: set "green room" reminder 20m prior -> 1797655209.

InfraOnCall: Standby assigned: @eng-runtime on call 17:40-19:00 PT. If demo latency >8s, advise cut to fallback asset at assets/fallbacks/clip_90s.mp4.

Jorie (Marketing): Topic line options — pick one: A) 'Cost-first inference: practical knobs that cut token spend' B) 'Shipping smaller models: preserving quality while lowering infra costs'. Which lands better for PLG audience?

Tess (Growth): A hits better for CTAs and snippets we can reuse in ads. B good for platform but narrower. Vote A.

Nadia (Host): Vote A. Also propose we add one slide with the explicit CTA: 'Try the cost-savings guide in our docs' + short promo code for attendees.

Ravi (Speaker): Agreed. I'll add a slide with a 3-step checklist and link to the guide. Also prepping a 90s prerecorded demo in case we flip.

Cal (Producer): Rehearsal plan (short):
```
17:30 join green room (host+producer+speaker+ops)
17:40 platform check + mic order
17:45 mic-check host -> speaker
17:50 rapid transitions run (intro->demo->panel)
17:58 final mute sweep
```

Jorie (Marketing): Two operational asks: 1) confirm captions & recording enabled (yes/no), 2) freeze slides by Mon 3pm PT.

InfraOnCall: Captions and recording toggles set to ON. Freeze accepted.

Tess (Growth): I'll monitor the Q stream during the show and mark leads to #webinar-1797-leads. For commercial questions, I'll ping @Ravi privately.

Nadia (Host): Who reads the audience questions aloud? I can do it, but need 1 person feeding me the highest-signal ones.

Tess (Growth): I'll feed you top Qs in the private channel. Also will push any demo interest into the lead channel.

Cal (Producer): One more: backup flow if demo fails — Host reads fallback script, we play assets/fallbacks/clip_90s.mp4, then panel proceeds. Everyone OK with that?

Ravi (Speaker): Yes. Fallback script uploaded in the doc under speaker notes.

Jorie (Marketing): Great. Final checklist: slides freeze Mon 3pm PT, captions+recording on, eng-runtime standby, private lead channel set. If no objections, this is final.

Nadia (Host): No objections. See you in green room.

Cal (Producer): StageBot: reminder scheduled: "Green room opens in 20m" -> 1797655209.

Ravi (Speaker): :thumbsup: uploading slides v2 now.

Tess (Growth): Thanks all — I'll seed the lead channel with the tracking doc before the event.

Jorie (Marketing): Perfect, closing thread. If anything changes ping me or Cal.
